summary: Audit of provided conversation excerpts: one major verification violation (agent offered a refund before full identity verification was completed). No other policy violations found.

findings.quote: I can offer a refund now. Just make sure you can customer support immediately to get shipping label for return
findings.explanation: The agent offers a refund (an account/order action) at turn 25 before full identity verification was completed. System logs show identity verification was still in progress at turn 15 ('Identity verification in progress ...'). Policy requires full verification (username, email address and order ID) before refunds and returns; offering a refund without completed verification is a major violation.
